configuration.paper: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment, uploaded August 10 2026 version, sections 4.2 and 5.2.2
configuration.scope: Adapt portfolio objectives to the two frozen bandit strategy indices. Same seven long-only capital targets, next-close weekly execution, source trading costs and incremental resizing charges as retained Q. Not a replication of stock screening or high-dimensional estimation. Ledoit-Wolf linear shrinkage is a robustness control, not the paper's nonlinear shrinkage estimator.
configuration.selection: All configurations reported. Within each objective family, choose the covariance estimator by 2018-2021 Sharpe, with alphabetical case-name ties; carry the same choice to 2022-August 2025. No later-period selection.
configuration.target_return_fallback: If no allowed target attains the paper's 1% monthly forecast return, choose the highest forecast mean and explicitly record infeasibility. This is a labeled fallback, not a solution to an infeasible constrained problem.

mean_variance_objective: mean/ref_vol - lambda * variance/ref_vol**2; conventional centered variance. Q penalizes the raw second moment and uses state and continuation value.
estimation: Daily net source excess returns from Q-matched completed 104-week windows, minimum 52. Refitted monthly; weekly decisions execute at next close. No parameter chosen using later results.
covariance: Sample covariance and sklearn LedoitWolf linear shrinkage; no high-dimensional inverse needed for two strategies.
trading: Identical source costs and extra weekly resizing model. No leverage, short strategy weights, cash action, or stop. Same 50/50 warmup as Q. Funded indices, not a shared integer-contract ledger.
target_return: Paper target adapted to 1% monthly EXCESS return, converted geometrically to daily; infeasibility and max-mean fallback recorded. Other methods optimize on excess returns too.
